t: The $(item)Thermal Compressor/$ is a simple compressor which uses the $(l:base_concepts/heat)temperature/$ differential on opposite (horizontal) sides to produce $(l:base_concepts/pressure)compressed air/$. The greater the temperature gradient, the more air that is produced.$(p)Note: trying to run this compressor purely from a $(l:machines/vortex_tube)Vortex Tube/$ won't work; you will get a net pressure loss.
$(item)温差压缩机/$是一种简单的压缩机，它利用两侧相对的（水平方向）$(l:base_concepts/heat)温度/$差来产生$(l:base_concepts/pressure)压缩空气/$。温度梯度越大，产生的空气就越多。$(p)注意：如果试图仅靠一台$(l:machines/vortex_tube)涡流管/$来运行这台压缩机，是行不通的；你会出现净压力损失。
$(italic)A Thermal Compressor using Lava and Packed Ice to provide a temperature gradient/$
$(italic)使用熔岩和浮冰提供温差的热力压缩机/$

The $(item)Thermal Compressor's/$ North-South and East-West faces are thermally connected to another, but there's no cross-connection between N-S or E-W, so you can have two independent temperature gradients on one compressor.$(p)Heat will equalize across the connections, so some effort will be required to maintain a useful temperature differential.
$(item)温差压缩机/$的南北两侧在热力上彼此连通，东西两侧也是如此，但南北与东西之间没有交叉连通，因此你可以在一台压缩机上形成两组彼此独立的温度梯度。$(p)热量会在这些连接之间趋于均衡，因此要维持有用的温差还需要花些功夫。

There are three primary situations where the $(item)Thermal Compressor/$ may be of use:$(li)To utilise waste heat (or cold!) from $(italic)one/$ side of a $(item)Vortex Tube/$. Normally you will only be using the hot or cold side of a Vortex Tube, and venting the other side via a $(l:machines/heat_sink)Heat Sink/$. However, the $(item)Thermal Compressor/$ offers the opportunity to reclaim some of this waste heat or cold as air pressure.
$(item)温差压缩机/$主要可在三种情况下派上用场：$(li)利用$(item)涡流管/$$(italic)一侧/$产生的废热（或冷量！）。通常，你只会使用涡流管的热侧或冷侧，并通过$(l:machines/heat_sink)散热片/$将另一侧排出。不过，$(item)温差压缩机/$提供了一个机会，可以将这部分废热或冷量回收并转化为空气压力。

$(li)To utilise the waste heat from advanced compressors such as the $(l:compressors/advanced_air_compressor)Advanced Air Compressor/$. Normally you would dump this heat into the atmosphere using one or more $(l:tools/heat_sink)Heat Sinks/$, but with the Thermal Compressor, it's also possible to reclaim some of this waste heat as pressure.
$(li)用于利用诸如$(l:compressors/advanced_air_compressor)高级空气压缩机/$之类的高级压缩机产生的余热。通常你会使用一个或多个$(l:tools/heat_sink)散热片/$将这些热量排放到大气中，但有了温差压缩机，也可以将其中一部分余热回收为气压。

$(li)If you have the means to obtain large quantities of naturally hot or cold substances, e.g. $(l:base_concepts/heat_sources)lava, or blocks from other mods/$, you may be able to use them to generate some pressure. You will likely also need to be able to automate the placement and removal of heat sources and spent sources; $(l:tools/drone)Drones/$ can do this, as can many other modded solutions.
$(li)如果你有办法获取大量天然的高温或低温物质，例如$(l:base_concepts/heat_sources)熔岩或来自其他模组的方块/$，你就可以利用它们来产生一些气压。你大概还需要能够自动放置和移除热源以及耗尽的热源；$(l:tools/drone)无人机/$和许多其他模组提供的方案都能做到这一点。

This compressor can be controlled by a $(#f00)redstone signal/$; if disabled, pressure generation stops, and the thermal resistance between the North-South and East-West faces greatly increases (a little heat will still leak across, but far less than when the compressor is running). This can be useful to store up energy as a heat differential when pressure is not needed, e.g. when your tube network is fully pressurized.
这台压缩机可以通过$(#f00)红石信号/$控制；若被禁用，将停止产生压力，同时南北面与东西面之间的热阻会大幅增加（仍然会有少量热量泄漏，但远少于压缩机运行时）。当你不需要压力时，这一点可用于将能量以温差的形式储存起来，例如当你的气动管网已经完全充压时。
